page.notes: Line "in Latinum conversas asserere, quod nor" reads "quod" followed by a mark and "nor"; the word is doubtful. The first word of the page is a fragment and continues from the previous page. Printed "à s[?]" at the end of the third line is cut off at the scan edge and uncertain. "Hieronv-" at the line end before "mum" is doubtful as printed. The hyphenated line-end "per-" is kept as printed. The word "Homilias" in italics is set in roman-italic in the original. The footer "Digitized by Google" is omitted.
